name: mailmypdf
description: Create, review, securely process, and mail document workflows through MailMyPDF.

interface.shortDescription: Create and mail PDFs from chat
interface.longDescription: Use MailMyPDF to write and revise ordinary letters conversationally or handle notices, appeals, disputes, records requests, claims, and other document problems, then review the exact PDF, envelope addresses, price, hosted checkout, physical mailing, tracking, and proof.
defaultPrompt: Help me respond to this attached notice and prepare a reviewable mailing packet.
Write a letter from these facts, show the exact PDF and envelope, and let me confirm both mailing addresses.
Check whether my MailMyPDF order was mailed and show any available tracking.
capabilities: Compose and review letters from chat
